---
name: Performance Improvement
about: Request to improve model performance / training or inference speed
title: "[Performance] "
labels: performance
assignees: ""
---

### Current State
> Current metrics (accuracy/F1/precision/recall/RMSE, etc., training time, inference speed, resource usage).

### Goal
> Target improvement figures and their rationale.

### Direction of Improvement
> Which area will be addressed: data (quality/volume), feature engineering, model architecture/hyperparameters, or pipeline optimization?

### Measurement Method
> Which dataset/benchmark and which metrics will be used to verify the improvement?

### Risks
> Impact of the performance improvement on other metrics (e.g., speed vs. accuracy) or on the reproducibility of existing results.
